objective: screen work-conjugate chamber mechanical pressure mappings under strict morphology V1.1 before deeper chamber-load rewiring

variants.label: Phase 5DO baseline inlet-held user0 pressure-flow frontier
variants.chamberMechanicalPressureContract: Baseline source-stress pressure path plus AV pressure-flow; no chamber mechanical adapter change

variants.label: Work-conjugate log-strain chamber pressure with AV pressure-flow
variants.chamberMechanicalPressureContract: Map Land source stress to pressure through Vw*d(log lambda)/dV instead of instantaneous Laplace gain

variants.label: Work-conjugate linear-strain chamber pressure with AV pressure-flow
variants.chamberMechanicalPressureContract: Map Land source stress to pressure through Vw*d(lambda)/dV instead of instantaneous Laplace gain

variants.label: Work-conjugate log-strain pressure plus AV/semilunar V2 leads
variants.chamberMechanicalPressureContract: Combine work-conjugate chamber pressure with the 5DM/5DO valve-law component leads
